summary: Implemented the window-title feature without committing and without running tests or repository code. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and a Tuple[ControlType, str] union member; rich/control.py adds the OSC 0 formatter entry and Control.title(); rich/console.py adds set_window_title(), gated only on is_terminal; rich/_windows_renderer.py adds a SET_WINDOW_TITLE branch that calls term.set_title once per control; CHANGELOG.md gets an Added bullet under Unreleased linking PR 2200. Tests added in test_console.py, test_control.py, and test_windows_renderer.py. All verification was by reading only; the tests have not been run.
